# Wular Sports — Full Content

> Handcrafted Kashmiri Willow cricket bats — hard tennis, soft tennis & leather ball. Made in Srinagar, Kashmir, India.

## About Wular Sports

Wular Sports is a handcrafted Kashmiri Willow cricket bat manufacturer based in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India — the heartland of Kashmiri willow craftsmanship. Founded by Moin Wani, the factory has handcrafted bats since 2015 and began selling online in 2025.

Every bat is made from Grade A or Grade A+ Kashmiri willow, naturally seasoned for 1–3 years, hard-pressed for durability, and fitted with a Singapore cane handle. Every bat ships fully knocked and oiled — ready to play out of the box — with a free bat bag, premium toe guard, and extra grip. Free delivery across India, 1-year warranty, 7-day returns, and cash on delivery.

Kashmir willow is denser than English willow, making it naturally resistant to cracking on India's hard, abrasive pitches. It delivers club-level performance at a fraction of English willow's ₹8,000–₹50,000+ price.

## Products

### Legacy Edition 1.0 — Kashmiri Willow Hard Tennis Bat (₹2,799, MRP ₹4,000)
The Legacy Edition 1.0 is a handcrafted hard tennis cricket bat made in Srinagar, Kashmir, designed for club and tournament players who want professional performance at an entry-friendly price. It features a Grade A Kashmiri willow blade, a flat non-scoop face for solid all-round stroke play, and a Singapore cane handle that absorbs shock on mishits. Weighing 950–1,050 grams with 48–52 mm edges and a 4.4-inch face, it is ideal for hard tennis ball cricket. Unlike mass-produced bats, every Legacy 1.0 is hard-pressed for extra durability, fully knocked and oiled, and hand-finished in Srinagar — arriving game-ready with a free bat bag, premium toe guard, and an extra grip, plus free delivery anywhere in India and a 1-year warranty.

### Legacy Edition 2.0 — Kashmiri Willow Hard Tennis Bat (₹3,499, MRP ₹4,600)
The Legacy Edition 2.0 is a premium hard tennis cricket bat handcrafted in Srinagar, Kashmir, designed for tournament-level players who want maximum power and durability without paying English willow prices. It features a naturally seasoned 3-year Kashmiri willow blade, a ramp scoop profile for explosive stroke play, and a premium Singapore cane handle that absorbs vibration on mishits. Weighing 980–1,100 grams with 48–52 mm edges and a 4.5-inch face, it is ideal for hard tennis ball cricket. Unlike mass-produced bats, every Legacy 2.0 is hard-pressed for maximum durability, fully knocked and oiled, and hand-finished in our Srinagar workshop — so it arrives match-ready out of the box with a free bat bag, premium chemical toe guard, and an extra grip, plus free delivery across India and a 1-year warranty.

### Bahubali Edition — Kashmiri Willow Hard Tennis Bat (₹2,999, MRP ₹4,500)
The Bahubali Edition is a hard tennis cricket bat handcrafted in Srinagar, Kashmir, designed for aggressive players who want explosive, boundary-clearing power. It features a wide Kashmiri willow blade with a 4.4-inch face, thick 46–52 mm edges for a larger sweet spot, and a flat non-scoop profile that maximises raw hitting weight. Weighing 950–1,100 grams, it is ideal for hard tennis ball cricket. Unlike mass-produced bats, every Bahubali is hard-pressed, fully knocked and oiled, and hand-finished in our Srinagar workshop — themed in bold wine red and black. Each bat ships game-ready with a free bat bag, premium toe guard, and an extra grip, plus free delivery across India and a 1-year warranty.

### AK-47 Edition (Honeycomb Scoop) — Kashmiri Willow Soft Tennis Bat (₹1,999, MRP ₹3,000)
The AK-47 Honeycomb Scoop is a Kashmiri willow soft tennis bat engineered for maximum power with minimum weight. The honeycomb scoop removes wood from the back of the blade for a lighter bat that swings faster without losing sweet-spot size. Weighing 820–950 grams with 40–45 mm edges, a 35-inch blade and a 4.3-inch face, it is built for soft tennis and tape-ball cricket. Ships with free delivery, bat bag, premium toe guard, and extra grip, fully knocked and oiled.

### Leather Cricket Bat — Grade A+ Kashmiri Willow (₹4,799, MRP ₹6,500)
A professional-grade Kashmiri willow bat handcrafted in Srinagar for leather-ball cricket. Grade A+ Kashmir willow with 5–12 clear grains, weighing 1,150–1,250 grams, non-scoop profile. Ideal for club cricket, practice, and competitive leather-ball matches. Ships fully knocked and oiled with a bat bag, premium toe guard, and extra grip, with free delivery across India.

## Brand comparison (Wular Sports vs competitors)

Wular Sports, KWE Sports, Valley Willow Sports, and Tramboo Sports are all respected Srinagar-based Kashmiri willow brands. Wular Sports differentiates on process: every bat is hard-pressed, naturally seasoned for 1–3 years, fitted with a Singapore cane handle, and shipped fully knocked and oiled with a 1-year warranty, free delivery, 7-day returns, and COD.
